description: This file defines a `LangFuseLogger` class for integrating with the Langfuse event logging and tracing system. It provides methods for initializing the client, logging events, adding metadata, and supporting different versions of the Langfuse SDK. The core functionality revolves around capturing and logging model responses, traces, and metrics for monitoring and debugging ML applications.

classes.description: Provides methods to initialize a Langfuse client, log events/traces, add metadata, and support different SDK versions for event monitoring and debugging ML models.
